prints.name: คาบิกอน
prints.catchUpOf: a Thai starter-deck catch-up code with no Traditional Chinese counterpart recorded here
prints.evidence: The Pokémon Company's Asia card database serves this card at /th/card-search/detail/439/, carrying the collector number 132/164, the card name "คาบิกอน", regulation mark D, and an a set-mark badge that renders "sc1D T" at size. The code is read off the rendered badge and the card image, never off the mark asset's filename, which here is "SC1D" — wrong case, and missing the locale letter the card itself prints. Identity rests on the number, the denominator, the card name and the regulation mark agreeing with it. Admitted under ADR-0001 D5 for language and identity only — a Thai starter-deck catch-up code with no Traditional Chinese counterpart recorded here. No finish is asserted and none may be inferred: a database page cannot be turned over. Retrieved 2026-08-10.

prints.evidence: The official European-Spanish promo asset is retained as SPEC-0034. It reads the complete printed code "SVP ES 184", carries the "Juntos de Aventuras" stamp, and uses "Presión Dinámica". The publisher's LATAM counterpart SPEC-0033 instead reads "SVP LA 184", carries "Aventuras Compartidas", and uses "Plancha Dinámica". The full printed modifier remains part of the local set code.
